title: lookup dependsOn: the import-mappings docs overstate the new lint's reach, and a tree field's formula filter key is still found only at import
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

Filing gate: ① (review follow-ups, one card per PR) · Source: fleet (contract review record 7217810288 on PR #37910, nits N1 and N2, accepted as deviations at ACCEPT)

## What happens

PR #37910 (Fixes #37717) refuses at author time a lookup whose `dependsOn` filter key names a formula of its target. Two edges stay open:

- [ ] **N1 (docs).** `content/docs/data-modeling/import-mappings.mdx` says an import meets the could-not-look-up sentence "only on metadata stored before that check". The lint does not see a target object outside the validated stack on the CLI, a target field changed from stored to formula after the owning object was published, or a reference field of a type outside the picker set (N2). Expected: the sentence names those cases, or says "mostly".
- [ ] **N2 (rule reach).** The importer scopes by `dependsOn` on every type in `IMPORT_REFERENCE_TYPES` (adding `tree` and legacy `reference`), while the lint judges the referenced half only on `lookup`, `master_detail` and `user`. A `tree` field with a formula filter key is still found only at import. The spec's `dependsOn` text declares scoping for `lookup`/`master_detail` only. Expected: either the lint covers the importer's set, or the importer stops scoping types the spec does not declare it for; say which.

Grade: area:data · documentation · reach: one docs sentence and one lint boundary · evidence: the record above
Suggested-grade: p3
Size: XS
Related: #37717, PR #37910.
